messages:
anya: heads up — nightly eval flagged a spike in long-context failures for q6-2026 on the 'long-run' prompt set. lots of truncation-style artifacts. :frowning:

sam: ugh. is this the new quantized build we rolled last night?

anya: yeah rolled q6-2026 at 03:12 UTC. nightly comparison shows +18% failures on long-run (>=16k tok). short prompts fine.

leo: can you paste one example generation?

anya: sure — here's the prompt and the model output (truncated):
```\nPROMPT: "You are an assistant that must list steps for migrating a database without downtime. Include commands and caveats."\nMODEL OUTPUT: "... Step 3: Run the migration. Step 4:"\n<abrupt end>\n```

maria: that looks like KV cache got reset or instruction tokens lost mid-seq. any logs from runtime?

anya: infra-bot gave a short log: `WARN: kvcache prefix mismatch at seq=16234, model=q6-2026, backend=rt-v2`. attaching snippet.

infra-bot: Deploy 03:12:07 q6-2026 -> rt-v2.pool-4
infra-bot: TraceID: f2d1...
infra-bot: WARN kvcache: prefix_hash mismatch for request 0x7a9 at token_idx 1024

sam: prefix_hash mismatch sounds like tokenizer changes or cache key derivation changed between variant builds. Did tokenization or EOS handling change in quant pipeline?

anya: quant pipeline changed per-token encoding to use separate pad-eos handling to squeeze size. but thought we tested tokenization parity.

leo: can we repro locally with the eval harness? request id + inputs?

anya: running now with harness sample id longrun-337. quick run shows same abrupt termination locally but only when we enable continuous-batching >1. single request path ok.

maria: aha — batching interaction. maybe KV offsets not correctly adjusted when merging batch cache?

sam: possible. previous bug we had was `window-shift` where batch merging used stale base_offset. but that was fixed in rt-v1. did the fix not carry to rt-v2?

anya: looking at rt-v2 change log — merge code was refactored. suspected file: `batch_merge.cpp` changed the offset arithmetic.

leo: quick test suggestion: run eval harness with `--force-separate-batches` and `--log-kv-offsets`. can we capture emitted offsets per-token?

anya: running that now: command: `./eval_harness --model q6-2026 --prompt-set longrun --force-separate-batches=false --log-kv-offsets`. results incoming.

dev-eval-bot: Job 1189 started. ETA ~4m.

anya: initial output: batch size 4 triggers offset drift after ~1024 tokens. offsets printed: base=0, merged_offset=0, applied_offset=-8, next_expected=1016 -> mismatch.

maria: applied_offset negative — definitely arithmetic bug. someone introduced a subtraction when handling pad tokens.

sam: assign to eng-runtime. @leo @anya can you open a hotfix PR to clamp offsets and add regression test for continuous-batching with long contexts?

leo: on it. I'll add a unit that simulates pad-heavy sequences and confirms merged offsets >=0. also add nightly eval bucket to run with batch sizes 1..8.

anya: I'll revert the pad-eos treatment in quant pipeline as a quick rollback for hosted until fix lands.

maria: sounds good. ops: can we roll back q6-2026 from hosted pool and redeploy q6-2025?

infra-bot: Rollback initiated: q6-2025 -> rt-v2.pool-4 at 12:45 UTC.

sam: good. add note to release changelog and incident. also create an eval alert that fires on >10% long-run regression so we catch this faster.

leo: PR opened: https://git.company/repo/pull/4321 — includes clamp + test.

anya: re-run nightly with rollback queued — early signs: failure rate dropped back to baseline. will monitor full sweep.

maria: great. follow-ups: (1) add explicit kv-offset logging for every merge in staging, (2) add nightly batch-size sweep for long-run prompts, (3) audit quant tokenization pad/EOS handling parity tests.

sam: assign tasks and update the postmortem template once fully validated. thanks team :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Job 1189 completed. 1 failing test reproduced locally (offset_clamp_test).

anya: leaving notes in the eval ticket: longrun-337 reproduction + logs + offset trace. will update when hotfix is live. :eyes:
